name: Sefaz-MT / Mato Grosso Government new state data center
developer: Secretaria de Estado de Fazenda de Mato Grosso / Government of Mato Grosso
notes: International tender for a new government data center and safe-room solution in Cuiaba under Profisco II/IDB; reported lot value around R$58 million. DevelopmentAid tender record was updated 2026-05-20.

name: Centro de Processamento de Dados do Estado de Mato Grosso (MTI)
developer: Empresa Mato-grossense de Tecnologia da Informacao / State of Mato Grosso
notes: Aggregator listing for the state processing center in Cuiaba reports 1.2 MW total power capacity; public primary details were limited.

name: MP-MS Modular Data Center
developer: Ministerio Publico do Estado de Mato Grosso do Sul / Zeittec
notes: MP-MS official notice says the modular data center began operating at the Campo Grande headquarters; DCD previously reported Zeittec as builder and later covered inauguration.

name: Adecoagro / Tether sugarcane-powered Bitcoin mining data center
notes: DCD and local press reported Tether-backed mining hardware adjacent to Adecoagro biogas/thermoelectric assets in Ivinhema and Angelica; crypto/local press later reported 10 MW and 1,280 machines beginning commercial mining in 2026.

name: RT-One Uberlandia AI Data Center Campus
notes: RT-One and Hitachi Energy describe the Uberlandia mega campus as part of Latin America's largest AI data center platform; public listings describe an initial 100 MW phase and expansion up to 400 MW on more than 1 million sq m.

name: SONDA Ativas Belo Horizonte Data Center
notes: SONDA markets a Tier III data center in Belo Horizonte; DCD reported the facility opened in 2011, spans about 6,000 sq m, and offers 2.5 MW.

name: Algar Tech Uberlandia data centers
notes: Aggregator and older trade coverage identify Algar data center operations in Uberlandia, with colocation services marketed by Algar; no current public MW capacity found.

name: Elea BEL1 AI Data Center
notes: Official Elea announcement places BEL1 in Belem, Para, with 7.5 MW initial AI-ready capacity, renewable power from AXIA, planned Q2 2027 operations, and expansion potential to 100 MW.

name: Tecto Belem Data Center
notes: Aggregator listings identify Tecto Belem as an existing facility in Para and the largest listed state facility by floor area; no operator primary page or MW capacity found in public search results.

name: HostDime Joao Pessoa Data Center
notes: HostDime operates a Tier III Design Certified facility in Joao Pessoa; DCD reported the site opened in 2017, spans 20,000 sq ft, supports up to 250 racks, and has 5.9 MW.

name: RT-One Maringa AI Data Center Campus
notes: RT-One says its Maringa campus sits on 400,000 sq m and is designed for GPU/HPC workloads; Hitachi Energy announced support for the Maringa and Uberlandia campuses. Public materials cite about 400 MW design scale, with other press describing phased delivery.

name: EVEO PR1 Curitiba Data Center
notes: EVEO launched PR1 in Curitiba in March 2023 as a Tier III-standard colocation/private-cloud facility; public sources did not disclose MW capacity.

name: TCE-PR Data Center Complex
developer: Tribunal de Contas do Estado do Parana / Zeittec
notes: Zeittec says it completed a Curitiba complex at the Parana Court of Auditors with a main safe-room data center connected to a secondary backup data center; DCD covered the award in 2023.

name: Cirion Curitiba CUR1 Data Center
notes: Cirion markets CUR1 in Curitiba as a carrier-neutral facility for colocation, managed hosting, and interconnection; no public MW capacity found.

name: Atlantic Data Centers Recife1
notes: Atlantic Data Centers' first project is Recife1 at Parqtel in Recife; local and trade coverage report Tier III targeting, phased development, roughly 14,000 sq m/150+ racks, and R$300 million total investment.

name: Vescnet Recife Data Center
notes: Aggregator listings identify a Vescnet facility at Rua Blumenau, Recife; Inflect reports 450 kVA total power, but MW was not directly provided.

name: Tecto Recife Campus (REC1)
notes: Baxtel lists a Tecto Recife Campus at R. Min. Mario Andreaza as an under-construction 2026 carrier-neutral data center; primary public operator details and MW capacity were not found.

name: Enegix Piaui 100 MW Bitcoin data center
notes: Enegix signed an MoU with local authorities in Piaui for a 100 MW, roughly US$120 million Bitcoin-focused data center; public search did not identify later construction confirmation.

name: Rio AI City
notes: Elea announced Rio AI City at Olympic Park with 1.5 GW certified renewable energy capacity in phase one, ability to scale to 3.2 GW, waterless systems, and first delivery starting in 2026.

name: Equinix RJ3 Sao Joao de Meriti Data Center
notes: Equinix lists Rio de Janeiro operations and public aggregators list RJ3; DCD reported the US$94 million RJ3 investment, 560 racks, 1,467 sq m colocation, and planned 2025 opening in Sao Joao de Meriti.

name: Ascenty Rio de Janeiro Data Centers
notes: Ascenty says it has two Rio de Janeiro sites. Local reporting describes Pavuna facilities with about 10 MW and 3 MW energy capacity respectively; capacity is recorded as combined because per-site primary capacity was not found.

name: Ada Infrastructure Rio de Janeiro Campus
notes: Baxtel nearby-site listing describes Ada's Rio de Janeiro campus as three single-story turnkey high-density data center buildings; no primary source or capacity found during this pass.

name: Albergue da Web Natal Data Center
notes: DataCenterMap lists Albergue da Web at Rua Raimundo Chaves in Natal and says it is the first data center in the city, offering hosting/cloud/bare-metal services since 2008; public capacity not found.

name: Metropole Parque / IMD-UFRN data center services
notes: IASP directory says Natal's Metropole Parque offers access to IMD/UFRN technological infrastructure including data center services; treated as a small institutional/park facility due to limited facility-specific public detail.
